title: Ledger Reconciliation Standard: Start of Interest Extinguished at a Whole Life Insurance Loan Offset
content:
On an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, interest extinguished at a loan offset runs from a date the policy ledger fixes.

## Standard

(a) The anniversary of the latest capitalization entry, where it is later than the loan interest paid-to date shown on the policy and no earlier than the date of the latest loan repayment (or the ledger shows no loan repayment);

(b) otherwise, the date of the latest loan repayment on the ledger, where that repayment paid loan interest and is later than the loan interest paid-to date shown;

(c) otherwise, the loan interest paid-to date shown on the policy.

A repayment paid loan interest when its entry includes an interest amount above zero. The anniversary of a capitalization entry is the anniversary that closed the interest year it capitalized.

## Reconciliation examples (hypothetical)

| Latest capitalization anniversary | Latest repayment (paid interest?) | Loan interest paid-to date shown | Interest runs from |
|---|---|---|---|
| March 1, 2025 | January 10, 2025 (yes) | March 1, 2024 | March 1, 2025 — rule (a) |
| March 1, 2025 | March 1, 2025 (yes) | March 1, 2024 | March 1, 2025 — rule (a), the dates being equal |
| March 1, 2024 | June 20, 2024 (yes) | March 1, 2023 | June 20, 2024 — rule (b) |
| March 1, 2024 | June 20, 2024 (no) | March 1, 2023 | March 1, 2023 — rule (c) |
| None | None | March 1, 2025 | March 1, 2025 — rule (c) |
